articleTitle: OpenAI’s ChatGPT Search Now 20% of Google’s, 250 Million Weekly Users

sources.title: OpenAI Says ChatGPT Search Volume Is Now About 20% Of Googles

claims.claim: OpenAI says that ChatGPT now handles roughly one search‑like query for every five that Google handles, which translates to about 20 percent of Google’s search volume.

claims.bestPassage: Its search volume, it says, is approximately 20% of Google’s.

claims.claim: The figure comes directly from Adam Fry, OpenAI’s ChatGPT consumer product lead, who presented the data at an OpenAI‑hosted dinner in New York.

claims.claim: Adam Fry presented a figure of 20 percent.
claims.bestSource: OpenAI: ChatGPT Search Is About 20% of Google’s, 250 Million People Speak With ChatGPT, and Chat Is Merging With Work - Big Technology | Alex Kantrowitz
claims.evidence: The company added 200 million users over just the past two months, jumping from 1 billion to 1.2 billion weekly active users in 60 days. Its search volume, it says, is approximately 20% of Google’s. Its users create 1.5 billion images with it per week. Bing’s share of the search market is around 5%. Does that make you multiple times larger than Bing? Adam Fry: ChatGPT has been growing quite quickly. ChatGPT’s volume of search-like queries is now roughly one-fifth the volume of queries of Google. During our conversation, Fry also revealed plans to merge ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes (so that confusing toggle up top will soon go away), agreed with feedback that ChatGPT-created restaurant signage looks too uniform, and addressed the cost to serve its personal assistant Dots. ChatGPT consumer product lead Adam Fry told me this during a brief fireside chat at an OpenAI-hosted dinner in New York City on Monday night. The growth is just going big, and we’re staying very focused on how fast ChatGPT is growing. I might have 20 prompts back and forth in a ChatGPT conversation. Adam Fry: What people came to ChatGPT for to start, if you go back about two years, is really writing help and coding help. Those wouldn’t be things that you really search for. It’s a pretty amazing statistic when you think about it, mainly because we started just about a year and a half ago. It’s hard to remember this, but ChatGPT at a time didn’t have any up-to-date information. You’d ask a question, it would say something like, “It’s past my training date,” and nobody had any idea what that meant.

editorial.claim: For businesses, the growth suggests that many consumers are turning to AI‑powered assistants for tasks traditionally handled by search engines.
However, because the precise measurement methodology is unknown, stakeholders should treat the 20 percent figure as an indicative benchmark rather than a definitive market share.
